oneLiner: Put GEN on your hot take. GenLayer validators decide who called it.
description: Called It turns a public hot take into a head-to-head bet settled by GenLayer validators. Compilation freezes a hashed rule before staking. The revision-5 v2 judge uses an ordered four-step decision and explicit archive capture times; validators independently judge evidence and verify every decisive quote. Real replays show Apple YES, Nintendo NO, the frozen default only for absent evidence, subjective rejection, and Grammy scheduling evidence VOID. Four newly wired contracts separate compilation, escrow, resolution and public records. A two-wallet 1+1 wei Apple bet settles to its winner, who pulls a verified native payout. Source failure or consensus timeout refunds both stakes. StudioNet GEN is simulated. The two earlier live takes and revision-4 timeout recovery remain on their original contracts. Real unreachable-source VOID remains unproven. The app exposes rules, evidence, rulings and finalized receipts without requiring a wallet.

howTo.heading: Inspect a take
howTo.instruction: Open the feed without a wallet. Read the frozen rule, hash, deadline and default. Historical replays are labelled; Read live queries finalized state.

howTo.heading: Compile before staking
howTo.instruction: Connect a StudioNet wallet, post one public claim and review its finalized rule or rejection. Prepare and fund the author stake only after reading the complete rule.

howTo.heading: Take the other side
howTo.instruction: Use a different wallet to reserve the counterparty slot. Review the ratio, exact matching stake and potential payout, then deposit before the reservation expires.

howTo.heading: Resolve from receipts
howTo.instruction: After the deadline, preview permanent sources and review the stored FETCHED or UNAVAILABLE preflight before sealing. Known-blocked hosts are rejected; failed sources never pay the default side. Then request one narrow ruling.

howTo.heading: Settle and verify
howTo.instruction: Settle a finalized result, pull the payout, verify its native child receipt and sync the public record. Review all receipts and run npm run verify:proof.

expectedOutcome: An accepted compilation freezes a precise rule before stakes. Absent evidence applies the default; source failure or consensus timeout refunds both sides. A judged bet resolves YES or NO; settlement conserves wei and the winner pulls a receipt-verified payout. Unaccepted and timed-out takes expose refunds. Only finalized matched settlements update profiles. The read-only proof verifier checks deployed code, actual outcomes, payouts and canonical explorer records.
